messages:
Anna: heads up — after the rollout yesterday we saw a 12% drop in prefix cache hit-rate on prod-gpu-2.
Kenji: ouch. any immediate signal for why? config change?
Anna: looks like a key-normalization tweak landed in the tokenizer path (strip_trailing_spaces = true). it reduced unique keys but increased collisions for mid-length prompts.
Michael: collisions -> more cache churn? that would explain thrash + higher p99.
Anna: exactly. KV cache eviction increased, LRU scanned more entries, and GPU memory fragmentation spiked.
InfraBot: [metric alert] prod-gpu-2 free_gpu_mem < 7% over 3m window.
Sara: did we also change batch heuristics? we rolled a small batching optimizer the same deploy.
Kenji: batching changes were on a separate flag, but they affect seq-lens distribution which can magnify eviction frequency.
Owen: I dumped a small profile: top offenders by allocs are kv_store.macros::insert and tokenizer::normalize_key
Anna: sharing snippets from the trace (abridged):
```
# hot paths
kv_insert  42%  (hotset evictions)
kv_lookup  18%
tokenize   15% (normalize_key)
batcher     8% (seq reshuffle)
```

Kenji: interesting. normalization decreased entropy for long prefixes, but collided for 32-128 token prompts.
Michael: can you paste the sample keys? maybe it's a hash salt/regression.
Anna: sample before/after (sanitized):
```
BEFORE: "user: how do I reset my password?\ncontext: ..."
AFTER:  "user: how do I reset my password? context: ..."
# removal of newline collided with other keys that had concatenated fields
```
Sara: we need a quick mitigation: revert normalization or add namespace separators in keying.
Owen: +1 for namespace separators. Revert is simple but we should avoid flip-flopping.
Kenji: also want to try TTL ramping: set short TTL for newly inserted keys for 30m then extend if hit-rate > 0.5 in 6h.
Michael: propose two-tier cache: small GPU-resident LRU for top-N hot prefixes, larger CPU-backed cold cache. Eviction moves from gpu -> cpu instead of drop.
Anna: CPU->GPU spill is part of the roadmap. for immediate relief, can we bump gpu_cache_size down 10% to reduce fragmentation and rely on cpu cache? that might lower p99 slightly.
Sara: bumping down makes eviction more frequent -> may increase roundtrips. need to coordinate with routing fallback.
Kenji: alternative: change eviction policy to size-aware LRU (weight by token_count) — large KV entries less favored than small ones.
Owen: we have perf harness to simulate this. I can run a synthetic replay with new keying + size-aware LRU tomorrow. ETA 6h.
Michael: add to experiment matrix: (A) revert normalization, (B) namespace separator + normalization, (C) size-aware LRU, (D) TTL-ramp + short initial TTL, (E) two-tier spill. measure hit-rate, p50/p95, gmem free, CPU swap.
Anna: agree. owners: Kenji for keying patch, Owen for simulation, Sara for runtime config toggles, Michael for metric dashboard.
InfraBot: scheduled job "kv-hotset-replay-1791002345" queued by Owen.
Anna: quick patch we can toggle via feature flag: add constant "\u0001" between fields when building key. Kenji can push PR if we agree.
Kenji: I'll open PR against release branch, add unit tests for collisions, and default to ON for canary.
Sara: canary plan: route 10% traffic to canary pool with new keying + size-aware LRU for 2h, measure hit-rate delta.
Owen: putting together a diff-run: will include memory fragmentation histogram and percent free_gmem over time.
Michael: please also capture kernel selection logs — sometimes different kernels allocate differently and affect fragmentation.
Anna: noted. thanks all — aim to have canary by EOD. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
Kenji: ETA for PR -> 2h.
Owen: replay started; will report when done.
Anna: (follow-up) replay shows hit-rate up +6% for namespace separator + normalization, fragmentation down 3%.
Sara: great, roll canary.
InfraBot: deploy started to canary pool (10%): deploy-1791002345-canary.
Michael: monitoring... looks stable so far. p99 improving slowly.
Anna: moving to roll forward if no regression in 1h.
Owen: full replay logs uploaded to /mnt/replays/1791002345.log
Anna: saved. final action items: Kenji merge PR, Sara schedule canary rollout to 50% after 1h, Owen run extended replay on 50% config. closing after rollout or if regressions appear.
Michael: thanks team.
